versions.changelog:
"1.2.1": "• Added introductory note: This skill is designed for AI assistants like WorkBuddy to assist with installing OpenClaw
• Removed specific large model recommendations; users may now choose their own
• Added prompt for pre-downloading installation files (for poor network conditions)
• Changed bilingual format to paragraph style: one English paragraph + one Chinese paragraph
• Added desktop shortcut creation: Ubuntu shortcut + one-click OpenClaw launch shortcut
• Supports two installation methods: recommended for regular users / direct root installation
• Added more common community errors and solutions
• Clearly states this skill is for AI tools similar to OpenClaw to assist with installation
• Added author credit: Deepwhite
• Adopted bilingual structure: English titles/code + Chinese comments",
